title: Remote foundations P-mac: macOS satellite lane — transport, process supervision and paths for a macOS satellite, proven by the onboarding checklist
outcome: Remote foundations P-mac: macOS satellite lane — transport, process supervision and paths for a macOS satellite, proven by the onboarding checklist
acceptance: A macOS satellite runs the satellite side of L1/M2/M4 natively (process supervision, paths, shell and signal handling), with platform-conditional code covered by tests that run on macOS and do not break the Windows gate.
The O1 verification checklist passes against the real Mac satellite (MacBookPro) in an operator-authorized session; SSH settings on the Mac are Greg's acts.
Linux and Windows satellites reuse the same lane structure: the platform-specific parts are isolated so that a later P-linux / P-windows slice adds a platform without redesign.
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate on A and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
